lines: With its muddled consciousness mired in insanity from the brainwashing, the weretiger faced off against the female ninja.
The weretiger had always held the position of apex predator in this criminal city.
A brawny, bestial body and sharp claws.
Its biological specs were clearly different from other people's from the get-go.

All people other than itself were prey. Based on its strong pride in that, the beastman blasted the female ninja who had suddenly appeared with a full-power “great roar”, and swung its claws down at the same time.
The cry of the crazed beast appealed to its enemy's biological instincts and bound their mind and body.
Up to now, there was no opponent it hadn't been able to fell with this combination――
「My, my? You're a noisy kitty cat.」
The claws the weretiger had swung downward were easily deflected by the woman's ninja katana.
It opened its eyes wide in shock.
She must have taken its roar head-on.
――Yet despite that, the woman's movements hadn't slowed in the slightest.
The “great roar” that had easily immobilized those young ninja earlier didn't work on her.
Had the woman before its eyes negated the “big roar's” binding spell through sheer force of will?
The weretiger was seized by an emotion it had never felt before in its life.
Overwhelming terror towards the woman in front of its eyes.
Now, it felt the woman's bizarrely strong fighting spirit tingling its skin.
They were on different biological levels. It was as if――
The woman before its eyes were a dangerous, ferocious predator, and it had been turned into a helpless kitten――
「Well then, I'll go this time. Ninja Art: Killing Formation Blossom―――」
Brilliant light danced all across the howling weretiger's field of vision.
About 30 minutes after Una had run off to lure the weretiger.
Having finally driven off the incubi, we had arrived at the rendezvous point, the construction site.
「You did great all by yourself, Una. We're saved, thanks to you.」
I called out to Una, who was strangely worn-out for some reason.
「Ah, not at all. Or rather—Fuuma-kun, if you called Asagi-sensei, you should have told me that!」
「My heart was pounding like crazy when I was running away!」
「Oh, sorry, sorry. I was in trouble too. I didn't have any time to spare.」
I was talking about the battle with the incubi.
The injured werewolf and I had been purely on the defensive until Mari and Mai reached the point where they could move.
After the two of them recovered, we had managed to repel the incubus force somehow.
「――And thank you very much too, Asagi-sensei, for coming all the way here to rescue us!」
I also called out to Asagi-sensei, who wore an unfamiliar white Taimanin suit.
The team she was accompanying was meant to be operating on nearly the opposite side of the city.

From that location, I figured it would be a close call as to whether she would make it in time for the rescue or not, but as you would expect from Asagi-sensei, it looked like she had hastened over to Una without any problems.
「Fufu, it's fine. I tagged along as a “supervisor” in preparation for this sort of eventuality.」
「And I also wanted to do a little trial run of this new combat suit.」
Saying that line, about the weretiger that we had struggled so much against.
It seemed we students were still nowhere near this person's level.
「Sorry, Una-chan. Mai-chan and I became unable to move at the crucial moment.」
「That's right! To make up for this, I'll call it even for three parfaits at the school cafeteria!」
When I looked over to them, the group of three close girls had reunited, and were praising each other's fighting efforts.
「Still, I'm really glad everyone's safe～...... Huh? What's that?」
「There's some weird puddle on the ground behind Una-cha――」
Just as Mari said, the ground right behind her was oddly damp.
Furthermore, so were Una's thighs, and the area around her waist――
「――Mari-chan, you don't see anything, got it?」
「This is...... a case of, “The most compassionate thing is to not say anything at all.”」
I didn't really get it, but the three of them seemed to be having fun, so I went with it.
The werewolf rushed over to his Kyoudai, which had been defeated by Asagi-sensei.
「Whoa! You really got it handed to you...... Well, I guess you'll heal this little pretty quick, though.」
「Is that all right? Suppose right after waking up, we get attacked again.」
I also examined the state of the collapsed beastman.
The weretiger, which had been beaten to a pulp by Asagi-sensei, was completely unconscious and groaning quietly.
「I got a potion from that alchemist.」
「You make someone drink this, and it weakens their demon power and returns them to human form――And apparently, it'll undo the incubus brainwashing while it's at it.」
When I had fought with this werewolf before, we had been aided by a medicine from Chevalier, an alchemist in this underworld town.
「But, she actually helped out like that?」
「W-Well...... In exchange, I was forced to sign a contract to do some work for her so-called research.」
「It's a pain, and annoyin', but, hey, desperate times, right?」
Since it was that alchemist we were talking about, the work almost certainly wasn't going to be above-board.
I felt deep sympathy for this surprisingly good-natured beastman.
「Well, that's for later. For now, I have to use this potion to――」
The werewolf poured the medicine into his brother's mouth.
At which point, smoke billowed up, as if to enshroud the massive weretiger's body――
「Huwaah...... That's great, Beastman-san. Now it's case closed♪」
All that was left was to return home to Gosha with the case.
When the smoke surrounding the weretiger cleared, standing there was a tiny, cute-looking girl.
「Grrrr...... What's wrong with being a woman, ya asshole?!」
「What? I toldja, didn't I? It's my “Kyoudai”, Torajiro.」
The werewolf told our astonished selves like it was natural.
Certainly, “Kyoudai” could also be spelled “兄妹” (sister).
But from that beastman's outward appearance, I never would have thought it was a girl.
When Asagi-sensei addressed her, the tiger girl suddenly jumped, and hid behind the werewolf's back.
She must have been through something that terrifying.
「Well, if she's a girl, that's all the more reason not to let her get captured by the incubi......」
「If I recall, this girl ran out on your organization because she had a fight with you, right?」
「Well, see... She's been givin' me this weird grief all the time lately――」
「It's not my fault!! It's 'cuz Aniki's been obsessed with that weird octopus lady!」
When that was said, there was one person in my circle that came to mind.
「Haah, haah... Hebiko's finally caught up. Asagi-sensei just went running off out of the blue...」
「Oh. There's a buncha other guys here too, huh?」
The ones who had arrived were the student Taimanin team of Hebiko, Shikanosuke, Maika and Jisai.
The four of them were on a different “improvised team” from ours tonight, and, with the backup of Asagi-sensei, had been conducting a bust of a wide-scale demonic narcotic trafficking group.
「It's been a long time, Hebiko-san!! Do you remember me?! So we meet again!!」
The werewolf (who was so excited that he had taken his beast form) was wagging his tail at Hebiko at full force.
「Ah! Hebiko remembers you～! It's been a long time, Wolfy-chan♪」
「Yip yip!! You remember me! I'm happy, so happy♪」
My spine went cold due to a bad feeling I had.
In all likelihood, that tiger girl probably loved the werewolf, her Kyoudai.
That would be why she had gotten into a fight and left the organization, not liking how lovestruck he was over Hebiko.
And now Hebiko, the cause of that, had appeared here――
『So you're the octopus lady who seduced Aniki, ya asshole!!』
That bad feeling was right on the mark――
Everyone went into an uproar due to the two beastmen who had suddenly appeared.
「What's this, a fight?!! This's gettin' fun!!」
For some reason, Maika and Shikanosuke were excited.
「Shishigami-san, isn't it? It's nice to meet you. I'm Nanase Mai.」
The two aloof girls were exchanging greetings upon meeting for the first time.
「Hyeeeeh?! Fuuma-kun, what do we do about this～?!」
「We'll just have to hold her back, won't we?! Asagi-sensei, please help us!」
「I suppose——something this minor should be no problem for you all.」
「I'm concerned about that incubus terrorist organization, so I'm going to go on ahead and crush them now.」
「――I'll leave the rest to you, Fuuma-kun♪」
With a face like she was just popping out to the convenience store, Asagi-sensei went off to crush the terrorist organization on her own.
「S-So, Hebiko-san...... Could I ask you to... be my email penpal......?!」
『Grr...... Don't do it, octopus lady!! Block him!!』
「Gimme a hand, Mari!! We're dragging these guys away!」
From nearby, I could still hear the roars of trolls, who sounded like they were searching for us.
If we made a racket in a place like this, no matter how many lives we had, it wouldn't be enough.
（Man, it sure is “still an exam mission until you get back home”――）
As I pacified the rowdy group, I got a real feeling for the truth of that motto.
